ImageDescription.value: The Saigon Opera House (An opera house in Ho Chi Minh City) is an example of French Colonial architecture in Vietnam. Built in 1897 by French architect Ferret Eugene, the 800 seat building was used as the home of the Lower House assembly of South Vietnam after 1956. It was not until 1975 that it was again used as a theatre, and restored in 1995. Saigon Opera House is a smaller counterpart of the Hanoi Opera House (built from 1901 to 1911, and shaped like the Opéra Garnier in Paris). The Saigon Opera House owes its specific characteristics to the work of architect Félix Olivier, while construction was under supervision of architects Ernest Guichard and Eugène Ferret in 1900 [Wikipedia.org]

Artist.value: Jorge Láscar from Australia

ObjectName.value: Le théâtre municipal (Hô Chi Minh Ville) (6762444557)

Categories.value: Taken with Nikon D200|Lam Son Square|Flickr images reviewed by File Upload Bot (Magnus Manske)|Photographs by Jean-Pierre Dalbéra|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Vietnam photographs taken on 2011-12-05

ImageDescription.value:
Le théâtre municipal est l'ancien opéra de Saigon

Construit en 1900, dans le style du Petit Palais à Paris, il donne sur la rue principale de la ville coloniale (la rue Catinat devenue la rue Dong Khoi) ; le théâtre municipal a été restauré et rendu à sa fonction première en 1975.

Il est situé place Lam Son, un lieu de rendez-vous des jeunes de HCM-Ville. Le théâtre est entouré de bâtiments récents de grande hauteur car le quartier est devenu le centre des affaires, des hôtels et du shopping

Credit.value: Le théâtre municipal (Hô Chi Minh Ville)
